2138. Searching for an Element in an Array Using Linear Search

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read N integers into an array, then read a key value, and determine whether the key is present in the array using linear search.

Description
Read an integer N, then read N integers into a one-dimensional array. Read a key value to search for. Use a loop to compare the key against every array element one by one, using an if statement to record the position if a match is found. After the loop, use an if-else statement to print the position (starting from 0) if the key was found, or print "Not Found" otherwise.
input_spec: An integer N, followed by N integers, followed by the key value to search for.
output_spec: Print the index of the key in the array if found, otherwise print "Not Found".
